newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer ups Chile in LatAm portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer ups Chile in LatAm portfolio.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co said on Monday it had upgraded its rating for Chile to market weight from underweight among its portfolio of Latin American stocks.
-- Analysts Vinod Sehgal, Todd Edwards and Carlos Asilis raised Chile's stake in the portfolio to 16.8 percent from 14 percent.

-- To accomodate the rise, they cut Colombia's stake to 2.5 from 3.5 percent and reduced its rating to underweight from modest overweight. Venezuela also was cut to one from two percent and its rating reduced to underweight from neutral.
